description:
Siren drafts an ad plan from one prompt: goal, audience, budget
inside the caps, platforms and the ads to make (shape, hook, headline,
text). Nothing is made or spent. Show the human the plan, then make_ads.
With test, the versions split one budget and the verdict rule is set
before any spend.

prompt.description: The goal in plain words, e.g. "more Pro signups from US founders, $20 a day for two weeks".

test.description: Make the plan a split test: "hook" tests openings, "words" tests the text. Omit for a normal plan.

name: plan_ads
